description: Claw Orchestrator — run Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok Build, OpenCode, any ACP agent and custom coding CLIs as one unified runtime. Drop into Hermes Agent, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, Zed, Windsurf, Goose or any Model Context Protocol
author: enderfga

tool_signatures.name: Council
tool_signatures.description: Several engines debate in isolated git worktrees and vote on a result.

tool_signatures.name: Model
tool_signatures.description: Model for this session. Switching model switches engine with it.

tool_signatures.name: Permission
tool_signatures.description: How much the agent may do without asking. Chosen up-front, not per turn.

tool_signatures.name: Ultraplan
tool_signatures.description: Long-horizon planning pass; produces a plan rather than edits.

tool_signatures.name: Ultrareview
tool_signatures.description: Parallel reviewers sweep the working tree and a synthesis pass merges findings.

tool_signatures.name: autoloop_chat
tool_signatures.description: Send a chat message to the Planner of a v2 autoloop run. Returns the Planner

tool_signatures.name: autoloop_list
tool_signatures.description: List all v2 autoloop runs in this manager process.

tool_signatures.name: autoloop_reset_agent
tool_signatures.description: Reset a single subagent (Coder or Reviewer) on a v2 run. Stops its persistent session; the next directive/review_request will re-prime from the system prompt + ledger artifacts. Use when an agent has drifted (repeated rejects, hallucinated context, token bloat). Planner reset requires force=true because it discards chat history with the user.

tool_signatures.name: autoloop_start
tool_signatures.description: Start a v2 autoloop run in chat mode. Planner, Coder, and Reviewer default to Claude (opus/sonnet/sonnet) but each role can use a different engine/model. Coder and Reviewer are spawned later by the Planner after plan approval. Returns a run_id and the Planner session name.

tool_signatures.name: autoloop_status
tool_signatures.description: Get current state of a v2 autoloop run (status, iter, push count, subagents_spawned).

tool_signatures.name: autoloop_stop
tool_signatures.description: Terminate a v2 autoloop run. Stops Planner (and Coder/Reviewer once spawned).

tool_signatures.name: council_start
tool_signatures.description: Start a multi-agent council that collaborates on a task using git worktree isolation, round-based execution, and consensus voting. Agents can use different engines (Claude, Codex) and models.

tool_signatures.name: council_status

tool_signatures.name: fanout_abort
tool_signatures.description: Abort a running fan-out by id (already-started agents finish; synthesis is skipped).

tool_signatures.name: fanout_start
tool_signatures.description: Run one task across N engine/model agents IN PARALLEL and collect their answers (optional synthesis). Cross-engine best-of-N / diverse-perspective primitive. No rounds, votes, or worktrees — use council for isolated parallel edits. Runs in background; poll with fanout_status.

tool_signatures.name: fanout_status
tool_signatures.description: Poll a running or finished fan-out by id; returns per-agent results and any synthesis.

tool_signatures.name: session_send
tool_signatures.description: Send a message to a persistent coding session and get the response

tool_signatures.name: session_send_to
tool_signatures.description: Send a cross-session message from one session to another. If the target is idle, the message is delivered immediately. If busy, it is queued in the inbox for later delivery. Use

tool_signatures.name: session_start
tool_signatures.description: Start a persistent coding session. Engines: claude (default) for the Claude Code CLI, codex for the OpenAI Codex CLI, agy for the Google Antigravity CLI, grok for the xAI Grok Build CLI, opencode for the sst/opencode CLI, or custom for any user-configured coding agent CLI.

tool_signatures.name: session_stop
tool_signatures.description: Stop a persistent coding session

tool_signatures.name: session_switch_model
tool_signatures.description: Switch the model for a running session immediately. Restarts the session process with --resume so the new model takes effect on the next message while preserving conversation history.

tool_signatures.name: session_update_tools
tool_signatures.description: Update allowedTools or disallowedTools for a running session. Restarts the session process with --resume to apply the new tool constraints while preserving conversation history. Rejects if the session is currently busy.

tool_signatures.name: sessions_overview
tool_signatures.description: Get an aggregate overview of all active coding sessions — readiness, busy/paused state, cost, context usage, and last activity for each. Use this for a dashboard view across all sessions. For single-session detail, use coding_session_status instead.

tool_signatures.name: team_list
tool_signatures.description: List teammates in an agent team session (requires enableAgentTeams)

tool_signatures.name: team_send
tool_signatures.description: Send a message to a specific teammate in an agent team session

tool_signatures.name: ultraapp_add_file
tool_signatures.description: Reference a local example file by absolute path (under $HOME or /tmp; symlinks and dotfiles rejected). Use this to attach reference inputs the interview can extract metadata from. For binary uploads from a browser, use the dashboard.

tool_signatures.description: Submit an answer to the current interview question. Either pick

tool_signatures.name: ultraapp_build_cancel
tool_signatures.description: Cancel a queued or in-flight build. Best-effort for in-flight; the worker is expected to honour its own cancellation signal (v0.2 only emits the event).

tool_signatures.name: ultraapp_build_start
tool_signatures.description: Enqueue a build for the run. Builds run serially. Watch ultraapp_status for transitions: queued → building → build-complete (or → deploying → done if a router is wired).

tool_signatures.name: ultraapp_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete a run completely: stops the container, removes the image, deregisters the slug, and removes the on-disk run dir at ~/.claw-orchestrator/ultraapps/<runId>/. Irreversible.
